period_note: BASIS: CONSOLIDATED, not Solo. This source (the bank's own website newspaper-style quarterly disclosure, a genuinely different and richer source than the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' BSEC table previously used for FY2019-2025, which is confirmed exhausted for FY2011-2018 -- no such table exists in any of those years' annual reports) presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Statement/Cash Flow Statement/Statement of Changes in Equity in every quarter checked FY2011-2018 -- no Solo section is printed in the main 3-panel layout. This is a REAL, PERVASIVE basis mismatch against this dataset's Solo Q4/annual series for all of FY2011-2018 (the whole block newly added this session), matching the same CONSOLIDATED pattern already documented for FY2022/2024/2025's interim quarters (as opposed to the SOLO FY2019-2021/2023 interim quarters) -- see sources.json and insights.json's reporting_basis/data_gaps fields for the full picture across all years. Cross-validated: this file's own figures satisfy Assets=Liabilities+Equity, NII=Interest Income-Interest Expense, Total Operating Income=NII+non-interest income, Profit before provision=TOI-TOE, Profit before taxation=PBP-Total provision, and Profit after taxation=PBT-Tax, all to the exact taka, and the equity components (paid-up capital+statutory reserve+other reserve+retained earnings+minority/non-controlling interest) sum exactly to Total Shareholders' Equity. Recovered via Wayback Machine (capture 2015-04-07) of the bank's old pre-2016 domain structure (premierbankltd.com/pbl/financial highlight/), not the current thepremierbankplc.com/financial-reports/ listing which does not go back this far (earliest Q1/Q3 entries there start at 2013). This is the ONLY 2011 or 2012 quarterly filing located anywhere on either domain after an exhaustive CDX search (~49,000 captures scanned on premierbankltd.com plus ~3,200 on thepremierbankplc.com) -- see sources.json for the full negative-result documentation on 2011 Q1/Q2 and all of 2012. NOTE: the Off-Balance Sheet Items exhibit page (equity.jpg's sibling, obs page) prints its comparative-period column headers as '30.06.2011 / 30.12.2010' instead of '30.09.2011 / 31.12.2010' used everywhere else in the same four-exhibit set -- this is treated as a typo in the bank's own original document (the figures themselves tie out exactly to the Total Off-Balance Sheet Items figure and to no other period), not a sign this is actually Q2 data. Figures independently cross-checked three ways within the document set itself: the Statement of Changes in Equity's own 'Net profit for the year' (327,586,072) matches the P&L's Profit after taxation + minority interest split exactly, and the equity roll-forward (Balance at 01 Jan 2011 6,277,115,732 + net profit 327,586,072 - transfers - bonus shares issued + minority = Balance at 30 Sep 2011 6,085,325,375) reconciles to the taka.
